purpose: Defines research-facing technology-transfer packages and rights so technology can be traded, licensed, stolen, brokered, or transferred without becoming a universal instant technology unlock. Diplomacy/economy systems own negotiation, payment, enforcement, and political consequences.

transfer_package_components.name: Observation Dossier
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Improves evidence/awareness and may prove a capability exists without revealing implementation.

transfer_package_components.name: Scientific Theory Dossier
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Provides codified theoretical knowledge; usefulness depends on translation and recipient field competence.

transfer_package_components.name: Engineering Blueprint Package
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Improves engineering understanding but does not include every tacit production detail.

transfer_package_components.name: Manufacturing Process Package
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Improves engineering/tacit readiness and can reduce manufacturing-dependency uncertainty. It does not include physical production tooling unless that is separately transferred.

transfer_package_components.name: Reference Hardware
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Physical evidence and possible operation/reverse engineering; portability and intactness matter.

transfer_package_components.name: Production Tooling Transfer
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Can enable foreign-process reproduction or supported operation before native process mastery.

transfer_package_components.name: Expert Assistance
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Adds scoped tacit expertise; does not create permanent native competence until knowledge is codified/trained.

transfer_package_components.name: Training Program
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Accelerates transition from interpreted/codified foreign knowledge toward trained/native practice.

transfer_package_components.name: Operating Institution Transfer
contents: functioning laboratory/factory/shipyard/process institution with routines and tooling
transfer_package_components.primary_effect: Can provide immediate supported operation or foreign-process reproduction while dependencies remain. Physical tooling embedded in the institution remains part of the institution unless separately extracted/transferred.

package_model.reason: A seller can transfer theory without manufacturing rights, tooling without full theory, experts without blueprints, or a complete bundle. Technology transfer should not be one universal 'sell tech' button.

rights.meaning: May use transferred material for internal scientific research.
May operate supplied devices/institutions subject to physical compatibility.
Licensed to manufacture implementations covered by the agreement.
Licensed to alter/derive from the transferred implementation.
May share defined material with covered allies/partners.
May export covered material/technology to third parties.
May issue manufacturing/use rights to others.
May resell the actual transferred package/knowledge asset.

license_dimensions.recipient_scope: named civilization, institution, alliance, or other contractual scope
license_dimensions.derivative_rights: whether native derivatives/hybrids are covered by restrictions

enforcement_rule.description: A civilization that physically possesses knowledge may violate licensing/export restrictions if it is technically able to do so. Diplomacy/law/intelligence systems model detection, sanctions, lawsuits, retaliation, trust loss, embargoes, or war. Research does not magically disable copied equations because a contract says no.
enforcement_rule.physical_copy_protection_possible: Actual encryption, authentication, DRM, biological locks, or machine-identity controls can exist only when implemented as real technology and may themselves be attacked/reverse engineered.

possession_vs_rights.lawful_transfer: Holder possesses package and rights defined by license.
possession_vs_rights.captured_or_stolen: Holder may possess physical/data assets with no lawful rights at all; research ability depends on access/compatibility, while political/legal consequences are external.
possession_vs_rights.brokered_asset: Holder can possess a package that is scientifically useless to itself yet commercially useful to another civilization.

research_side_inputs: current Research Pressure/strategic need relevant to the capability
risk that rivals gain the same technology
buyer_specific_value_assessment.ai_information_rule: AI evaluates only demand, buyers, rivals, compatibility, and market information it legitimately knows or estimates.

brokerage_examples: A human civilization acquires aquatic life-support technology it cannot use, but sells it to another aquatic species.
A merchant civilization buys nonexclusive manufacturing process data because it legitimately knows several buyers need it.
A conquered alien factory remains valuable because the holder can sell operating access or tooling even before understanding the science.
A license forbids military use; the recipient can violate the clause if technically able, creating political consequences rather than an invisible prohibition.
